item.title: 【環境】 Maximizing electrochemical carbon dioxide reduction to achieve closed-loop reactive capture
item.description: Directly converting captured carbon dioxide into fuels and chemicals could make carbon capture more efficient by avoiding energy-intensive solvent regeneration. This Review discusses the reaction pathways, key challenges and strategies for achieving high carbon conversion.
